changes.beforeKo: 경로를 편집할 때, 곡선 위의 점 대신 바깥에 있는 손잡이를 움직이는 경우가 있습니다. 손잡이는 지나가지도 않는데 왜 길의 모양을 바꿀까요? 베지에 곡선은 이 손잡이들을 반복해서 섞어 만들어집니다. 그 과정을 눈으로 따라가고, 출발 방향을 조절한 뒤, 같은 곡선을 필요한 구간으로 잘라 보겠습니다.
changes.afterKo: 슈퍼 마리오 메이커 투의 트랙 편집을 보세요. 각진 경로를 구부리고, 구간들을 이어 둥근 고리를 만듭니다. 이렇게 곡선의 모양을 쉽게 조절하려면 어떤 숫자를 사용하면 좋을까요? 이번에는 곡선 밖의 제어점으로 형태를 잡는 베지에 곡선을 만들고, 같은 경로를 원하는 구간으로 나눠 보겠습니다.
changes.beforeEn: A path editor may let you shape a curve by moving handles outside it. Why does a point the path never visits change its shape? A Bézier curve is built by repeatedly blending those controls. We will follow that construction, control its endpoint directions, then extract smaller pieces without changing the path.
changes.afterEn: Watch track editing in Super Mario Maker 2. Angular sections become rounded corners and join into a loop. What numbers would make a curved shape easy to control? We will build our own Bezier curve using control points outside the path, then split the same curve into the portions we need.
changes.reason: Actual path editing opens thesis; do not identify Nintendo's internal curve representation. Outside control-point role remains taught immediately in002 and iterative blending in003.

changes.beforeEn: Now calculate departure direction. Differentiate the power form and substitute zero: the starting derivative is three times the difference b one minus b zero. changes.afterEn: Recall Mario launching toward another planet in Super Mario Galaxy. A path is shaped not only by its destination, but also by the direction in which it begins. changes.reason: Real departure and curved flight motivate endpoint tangent; do not attribute Bezier implementation to Mario.

changes.afterEn: Higher degrees produce Pascal's triangle: ones on the edges, and each interior number the sum of the two above. At either end, only the corresponding endpoint weight is one, so the curve interpolates its endpoints.
